name: manuscript_writing_agent_files_init
title: Manuscript Writing Agent Files
description: Invoke the base agent-files scaffold for a LaTeX IEEE paper workspace, keep AGENT.md immutable, and install a bounded manuscript-writing harness extension.

target_dir.description: Directory where the parent agent-files scaffold will be created before manuscript-writing harness handling

mission.description: One- or two-sentence long-term manuscript-writing mission statement passed through to agent-files and written into AGENT_GOAL.md. Required so the scaffolded contract is internally consistent on first read; must not include workflow preferences, current state, next steps, external coordination tasks, or transient objectives

objective.description: Concrete transient in-flight manuscript-writing objective written into AGENT_PROGRESS.md. Must not define permanent mission, manuscript scope, policy, or success criteria. If omitted, the scaffolded AGENT_PROGRESS.md omits the Current Objective section entirely

overwrite.description: If true, existing parent scaffold files may be replaced by agent-files, and this skill refreshes only the child-owned manuscript-writing harness section. If false, parent files are skipped only after agent-files compatibility checks and the child harness extension is skipped only after compatibility inspection for durable reusable manuscript-writing rules with no mission, current-state, artifact-inventory, blocker, or sidecar content

patches_applied.description: Child-owned section patch names applied or verified, such as manuscript_writing_playbook. Section-only edits are not reported as files_created.
